description: CREATE a Robinhood Chain coordination alert rule (POST — this writes and consumes quota). Fires when min_kols+ distinct tracked KOLs buy the same RHC token within window_minutes and the cluster scores at least min_score. SCORING CAVEAT: the shared v1 scorer is used so the number is comparable to Solana, but on RHC the `earliness` component is DEFAULTED to 50 (RHC has no early-entry equivalent) while `quality` is real (KOL 7d win-rate); every fired signal records which components were real in score_inputs. Delivered on the rhc:kol:coordination WS channel and/or an HMAC-signed webhook; webhook_secret is returned EXACTLY ONCE. Rule quota is PER CHAIN (PRO 5, ULTRA 20, BUSINESS 100); exceeding it returns 409. Tier: PRO+.

cooldown_min.description: Silence per (rule, token) in minutes (1-1440, default 30)

max_mc_usd.description: Maximum token market cap — must be >= min_mc_usd

min_kols.description: Minimum distinct KOL buyers to fire (2-50, default 3)

min_mc_usd.description: Minimum token market cap, or null for no floor

score_jump_break.description: Re-fire inside the cooldown when the score jumps this many points (0-100, default 20)

webhook_url.description: HTTPS URL — REQUIRED unless delivery_mode is 'websocket'

window_minutes.description: Rolling cluster window in minutes (1-60, default 15)

name: rhc_coordination_alerts_create
